title: Kashti-e-deen
body:
Ya Hussein[as] ×4
{Mera Asgher(as) Haye Mera Asgher(as)
Mera Asgher(as) Mera Asgher(as)} x2
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x2
Khoon mei ghark na khuda dekha
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x2
(1)Goud mei phir na aasake Asgher[as] ×2
Muddato maaN ne rasta dekha
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x2
(2)KhooN bhare aasmaa(N) ke taro ne x2
Chand imamat ka doobta dekha
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x2
(3)Maa hai ran se samajh gaye Asgher[as] ×2
Parda khaime ka jab utha dekha
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x2
(4)Sari dunya ne ay Ali Asgher[as] ×2
Nanhe se dil ka hosla dekha
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x2
(5)Zindagi aur maut ka Asgher[as] ×2
Muskurahat mei faisla dekha
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x2
(6)Lashe Akbar(as) ke paas baith gaye x2
Ab Khuda jaaney Sheh ne kya dekha
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x2
(7)Fazl ne sar wahi(N) rakha Shabbir[as] ×2
Jis jagah tera naqsh e paa(N) dekha
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x2
Khoon mei ghark na khuda dekha
Kashti e deeN ne asra dekha x4
{Mera Asgher(as) Haye Mera Asgher(as)
Mera Asgher(as) Mera Asgher(as)} x2
